# FDG8081

> DO overload `ToString(string format)`, or implement `IFormattable`, if the string returned from `ToString()` is culture-sensitive or there are various ways to format the string. For example, `DateTime` provides the overload and implements `IFormattable`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.3 Object.ToString.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

The text has no body. Not machine-checkable: whether the string is culture-sensitive or has several formats is judgment.
